metadata.description: Comprehensive directory of all law enforcement agencies, communication channels, media sources, and monitoring infrastructure for Albany County, New York.
metadata.sourceNotes: Compiled from official agency websites, RadioReference, Broadcastify, Nixle, and verified media sources. Social handles and URLs confirmed against official pages where accessible.

agencies.name: FBI — Albany Field Office
agencies.jurisdiction: 32 counties in northern New York plus all of Vermont

recordsAccess.notes: eFOIA portal for all FBI records requests

agencies.notes: Largest federal LE footprint in the county by investigative scope.

agencies.name: DEA — Albany District Office (New York Division)
agencies.jurisdiction: Federal drug enforcement; New York Division with Albany district office

agencies.name: ATF — Albany Field Office (New York Field Division)
agencies.jurisdiction: Federal firearms, explosives, arson, and tobacco enforcement
agencies.notes: Also accepts tips via ReportIt app.

agencies.name: U.S. Marshals Service — Northern District of New York
agencies.jurisdiction: Federal judicial district; Albany courthouse location. Operates Albany Fugitive Task Force.

contact.address: 445 Broadway, James T. Foley U.S. Courthouse

agencies.notes: Fugitive task force phone: 518-472-5444.

agencies.name: ICE/HSI — Albany Sub-Office (Buffalo Field Office)
agencies.jurisdiction: Immigration enforcement and homeland security investigations; Albany and surrounding counties

agencies.name: U.S. Secret Service — Albany Field Office
agencies.jurisdiction: Protective and investigative (financial crimes) missions
agencies.notes: Full field office (not a resident office). Also reported at 39 North Pearl Street.

agencies.name: U.S. Postal Inspection Service — Boston Division (Albany domicile)
agencies.jurisdiction: Mail-related federal crimes

agencies.name: IRS Criminal Investigation — New York Field Office (Albany agents)
agencies.jurisdiction: Tax fraud, financial crimes

agencies.name: U.S. Customs and Border Protection — Albany Port of Entry
agencies.jurisdiction: Customs at Port of Albany (maritime) and Albany International Airport

agencies.name: U.S. Attorney's Office — Northern District of New York
agencies.jurisdiction: Federal prosecution for the Northern District of New York

agencies.name: U.S. Probation Office — NDNY (Albany Division)
agencies.jurisdiction: Federal probation and pretrial services

agencies.name: Federal Protective Service — DHS Region 2
agencies.jurisdiction: Federal buildings: Foley Courthouse, Leo W. O'Brien Federal Building, other federal facilities
agencies.notes: Uniformed officers and contract guards protect federal facilities in Albany.

agencies.name: SSA Office of Inspector General
agencies.jurisdiction: Social Security disability and SSN fraud in the Albany region

agencies.name: VA Police — Samuel S. Stratton VA Medical Center
agencies.jurisdiction: VA Health Care campus, 113 Holland Avenue

recordsAccess.notes: Police report requests via FOIA to local VA privacy/FOIA office

agencies.name: Watervliet Arsenal — Military Police / Security
agencies.jurisdiction: U.S. Army installation, City of Watervliet
agencies.notes: DSN 374-5214. One of the oldest continuously operating manufacturing arsenals in the U.S.

agencies.name: New York State Police — Troop G
agencies.jurisdiction: Albany and nine surrounding counties; Capitol and Empire State Plaza security

newsPressSurfaces.label: NYSP Newsroom
newsPressSurfaces.notes: Filterable by troop/location; Troop G dateline = Latham

agencies.notes: No separate Capitol Police exists in New York; NYSP handles Capitol/ESP security through Troop G.

agencies.name: New York State Police — Troop T (Thruway)
agencies.jurisdiction: NYS Thruway through Albany County

agencies.name: NYS Park Police — Saratoga/Capital Zone
agencies.jurisdiction: State parks and historic sites; Capital Zone includes Albany County

recordsAccess.notes: Incident reports via State Parks FOIL link on Park Police page

agencies.name: NYS DEC Environmental Conservation Officers & Forest Rangers — Region 4
agencies.jurisdiction: Environmental law enforcement; Region 4 covers Albany and eight surrounding counties

recordsAccess.notes: DEC FOIL via records access officer; online submission available

agencies.notes: Forest Rangers hotline: 1-833-NYS-RANGERS.

agencies.name: NYS Department of Corrections and Community Supervision
agencies.jurisdiction: State correctional facilities and community supervision/parole statewide; Central Office in Albany

agencies.name: NYS Office of the Attorney General — Criminal Justice Division
agencies.jurisdiction: Statewide: Office of Special Investigation, Organized Crime Task Force, Medicaid Fraud Control Unit, Public Integrity Bureau

agencies.name: NYS Inspector General
agencies.jurisdiction: Oversight of state agencies, Gaming Commission integrity

agencies.name: NYS Division of Homeland Security and Emergency Services
agencies.jurisdiction: Statewide homeland security, emergency management, counterterrorism

agencies.name: NYS Division of Criminal Justice Services
agencies.jurisdiction: Sex Offender Registry, DNA Databank, LE accreditation, criminal justice policy

agencies.name: NYS Unified Court System — Court Officers
agencies.jurisdiction: State courthouses and judicial facilities

agencies.name: NYS Dept. of Taxation and Finance — Criminal Investigations Division
agencies.jurisdiction: State tax fraud investigations

agencies.name: NYS Liquor Authority — Enforcement Bureau
agencies.jurisdiction: Liquor law enforcement
agencies.notes: Complaints: https://sla.ny.gov/file-complaint

agencies.name: NYS Department of Financial Services — Investigations
agencies.jurisdiction: Financial fraud, insurance fraud investigations

agencies.name: NYS Office of the Medicaid Inspector General
agencies.jurisdiction: Medicaid fraud investigations

agencies.name: NYS Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government
agencies.jurisdiction: Ethics enforcement for state officials and lobbyists

agencies.name: NYS Comptroller's Office — Investigations Division
agencies.jurisdiction: State fraud investigations

agencies.name: Albany County Sheriff's Office
agencies.jurisdiction: Countywide patrol, criminal investigation, court security, airport LE, E911/Communications Center

recordsAccess.notes: Public requests and searchable prior requests; partial public reading room

dispatch.notes: E911/Communications Center is the PSAP for multiple local agencies

agencies.notes: Established in the 1660s; one of America's oldest sheriff's offices. Also provides 22 sworn deputies at Albany International Airport 24/7.

agencies.name: Albany County E911 / Communications Center
agencies.jurisdiction: Primary PSAP for Albany PD, Colonie PD, Bethlehem PD, Guilderland PD, Menands PD, NYSP (ESP), Cohoes PD/Fire, Watervliet PD/Fire, Green Island PD/Fire, Coeymans PD/Fire, plus volunteer fire companies and ambulance services

dispatch.notes: Key insight: initial incident details for many jurisdictions originate from this shared county dispatch

agencies.notes: Dispatch logs not published online in real time; obtainable via FOIL. Central nervous system for most local LE radio traffic.

agencies.name: Albany County District Attorney's Office
agencies.jurisdiction: County criminal prosecution
agencies.notes: Elected November 2024.

agencies.name: Albany County Probation Department
agencies.jurisdiction: County probation supervision

agencies.name: Albany County STOP DWI Program
agencies.jurisdiction: DWI enforcement coordination, education, and victim impact panels

agencies.name: Albany County Crime Victim and Sexual Violence Center
agencies.jurisdiction: Victim services and advocacy

agencies.name: City of Albany Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: City of Albany; excludes State Capitol grounds and UAlbany campus (special jurisdictions)

recordsAccess.notes: City accepts electronic FOIL via GovQA; tracking and faster response

agencies.notes: Largest municipal force in the county. Also has SeeClickFix integration: https://seeclickfix.com/albany_2/report

agencies.name: Town of Colonie Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: Town of Colonie (also covers Village of Colonie)
agencies.notes: One of the Capital Region's largest suburban departments.

agencies.name: Town of Guilderland Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: Town of Guilderland

recordsAccess.notes: Incident reports for non-complainants must be obtained via FOIL through town clerk

newsPressSurfaces.label: Records & Reports Page
newsPressSurfaces.notes: Explains incident-report access and FOIL gating

agencies.name: Town of Bethlehem Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: Town of Bethlehem

alertChannels.notes: CivicEngage Notify Me lists for police press releases

recordsAccess.notes: Town FOIL page and form; police records requests routed to police records office email

newsPressSurfaces.label: Police Press Releases
newsPressSurfaces.notes: CivicAlerts category with RSS endpoint and Notify Me tool; low-volume/episodic

agencies.name: City of Cohoes Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: City of Cohoes

alertChannels.notes: Emergency Notifications link routes to AlertSense domain

recordsAccess.notes: Police Forms Center contains a FOIL request PDF

newsPressSurfaces.label: Police Latest News & Events
newsPressSurfaces.notes: CivicAlerts/News Flash with archive and RSS; moderate volume, structured publishing

agencies.name: City of Watervliet Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: City of Watervliet

recordsAccess.notes: Reports require FOIL request via City Clerk per department FAQ

agencies.name: Village of Menands Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: Village of Menands
agencies.notes: Village website is JavaScript-gated; some automated data retrieval may fail.

agencies.name: Village of Green Island Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: Village of Green Island
agencies.notes: Minimal digital footprint; primary online presence is a single Facebook page and village website listing.

agencies.name: Village of Altamont Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: Village of Altamont

agencies.name: Town of Coeymans Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: Town of Coeymans; also covers Village of Ravena (police abolished by voter referendum 2006)

alertChannels.notes: Town site Subscribe for News & Updates email sign-up

agencies.name: University at Albany (SUNY) — University Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: Campus properties and certain nearby leased/rented facilities; 24/7 sworn policing

alertChannels.notes: Send Word Now system for campus alerts

agencies.notes: Only fully sworn campus police force in the county; DCJS-certified officers with arrest powers.

agencies.name: Siena College — Department of Public Safety
agencies.jurisdiction: 515 Loudon Road, Loudonville (Town of Colonie)
agencies.notes: Non-sworn, NYS Security Guard licensed officers. Anonymous tip line: 518-783-2999.

agencies.name: University Heights Association — Department of Public Safety
agencies.jurisdiction: Albany Law School, Albany College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences (ACPHS), Russell Sage College (Albany campus)
agencies.notes: Non-sworn officers serving contiguous campuses. MOU with Albany PD for criminal investigations.

agencies.name: Albany Medical College / Albany Medical Center — Security
agencies.jurisdiction: Albany Medical Center campus
agencies.notes: Criminal matters referred to Albany PD.

agencies.name: CDTA Transit Enforcement / Ambassador Program
agencies.jurisdiction: Capital District Transportation Authority bus and BRT network
agencies.notes: Fare compliance enforcement and uniformed Ambassador Program in partnership with Tech Valley Security. Report concerns via CATS-Pass app.

agencies.name: CSX Railroad Police
agencies.jurisdiction: CSX property including Selkirk Yard (one of Northeast's largest rail facilities)
agencies.notes: Full law enforcement authority on CSX property under federal statute.

agencies.name: Amtrak Police Department
agencies.jurisdiction: Albany-Rensselaer station (technically Rensselaer County but serves Albany metro) and Amtrak rail corridor

agencies.name: Albany Housing Authority — Security
agencies.jurisdiction: AHA housing developments in City of Albany
agencies.notes: Uses off-duty Albany Police officers under a tri-party agreement. Security Director: Nate Pendelton.

agencies.name: Albany Community Police Review Board
agencies.jurisdiction: Oversight and misconduct-complaint intake for Albany PD

newsPressSurfaces.label: CPRB Statements
newsPressSurfaces.notes: Publishes statements/press releases via city site; complaint e-form available

agencies.notes: Primary source for APD oversight activity and complaint process.

municipalities.notes: Hilltowns; NYSP New Scotland station serves as hub

system.name: Albany/Schenectady Counties P25 Phase II Trunked System
system.notes: Albany PD, Colonie PD, and most major agencies operate on this digital system. Legacy analog frequencies serve as tactical supplements. Encryption choices constrain public listening on some talkgroups.

feeds.label: Albany County Scanner Feeds (County Page)
feeds.coverageDescription: All publicly streamed Albany County feeds
feeds.notes: Premium required for feed archives and ad-free listening

feeds.label: Albany City & Colonie PD/Fire/EMS
feeds.coverageDescription: Albany City and Colonie police, fire, and EMS

feeds.label: Albany County P25 Talkgroup Playback
feeds.coverageDescription: Unencrypted talkgroups on the Albany/Schenectady P25 system; playback and search
feeds.notes: Semi-public archival surface; availability depends on encryption and recorder configuration

feeds.label: RadioReference — Albany County Frequencies & Systems
feeds.coverageDescription: Comprehensive database of all frequencies, trunked talkgroups, and system details
feeds.notes: Discovery and categorization resource; some deeper datasets require RadioReference membership

conventionalFrequencies.use: County Fire Dispatch (patched to P25 TG 10702)

mediaSources.name: Times Union
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Crime/public safety, policing policy, accountability, courts; extensive APD and oversight coverage
mediaSources.reliabilityNotes: Original reporting plus document-based coverage; mediated through editorial framing
mediaSources.notes: Primary newspaper of record for the Capital Region

mediaSources.name: WNYT NewsChannel 13
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Daily crime and policing stories; maintains Albany Police Department tag archives
mediaSources.reliabilityNotes: Generally reliable for breaking news; often based on police statements plus on-scene reporting

mediaSources.name: CBS6 Albany / WRGB
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Public safety reporting and social-media policy developments
mediaSources.reliabilityNotes: Generally reliable; reported APD disabling social media comments

mediaSources.name: Spectrum News 1 Capital Region
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Dedicated Public Safety vertical for the Capital Region; frequent pieces involving Albany-area policing and policy
mediaSources.reliabilityNotes: Generally reliable regional reporting; stories may rely on official statements with added context

mediaSources.name: FOX23 / WXXA
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Shared news operation with NEWS10 ABC

mediaSources.name: Daily Gazette
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Regional crime/courts; publishes Bethlehem police blotter entries
mediaSources.reliabilityNotes: Local newspaper with strong regional reporting

mediaSources.name: WAMC 90.3 FM Northeast Public Radio
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Policy/civic accountability framing and interviews; coverage of oversight bodies and advocacy
mediaSources.reliabilityNotes: High reliability for civic context; often includes direct quotes and meeting/record context

mediaSources.name: Spotlight News
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Most detailed weekly police blotters in the county; covers Colonie, Bethlehem, and Guilderland
mediaSources.reliabilityNotes: Useful blotter aggregation; cross-check with official records when needed

mediaSources.name: The Altamont Enterprise & Albany County Post
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Strong town/village crime beat (notably Guilderland); direct citations to police releases and investigator contacts. Covers Guilderland, New Scotland, Berne, Knox, Westerlo, Rensselaerville.
mediaSources.reliabilityNotes: Useful for granular local reporting; cross-check release-based items with underlying police records
mediaSources.blotterCoverage: Guilderland, New Scotland, Berne, Knox, Westerlo, Rensselaerville

mediaSources.name: Ravena News-Herald
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Southern Albany County (Coeymans/Ravena area) police and court reports

mediaSources.name: Patch.com — Albany / Colonie / Bethlehem editions
mediaSources.coverageFocus: Police/crime briefs for Albany, Colonie, and Bethlehem
mediaSources.reliabilityNotes: Aggregates police press releases and local crime news; limited original reporting

communityPlatforms.name: Nixle — Albany County Agencies
communityPlatforms.description: Dominant SMS/email alert system. Agencies include Albany PD, Colonie PD, Guilderland PD, Watervliet PD, Altamont PD. Enroll by texting ZIP code to 888777.
communityPlatforms.notes: County-wide directory at the URL above. Each agency has agency-specific keywords.

communityPlatforms.name: Capital Region Crime Stoppers
communityPlatforms.description: Anonymous tip line covering all Albany County law enforcement. Rewards up to $5,000.

communityPlatforms.name: SpotCrime
communityPlatforms.coverageArea: City of Albany and surrounding areas
communityPlatforms.description: Aggregates crime data with email alerts and map visualization.

communityPlatforms.name: Citizen App
communityPlatforms.description: Real-time scanner-based alerts and incident notifications.

communityPlatforms.name: Ring Neighbors
communityPlatforms.coverageArea: Varies by doorbell adoption density in Albany County
communityPlatforms.description: Community safety alerts from Ring doorbell owners.

communityPlatforms.name: SeeClickFix — Albany
communityPlatforms.description: Quality of life and non-emergency issue reporting integrated with city services.

communityPlatforms.name: Albany Open Data Portal
communityPlatforms.description: Geocoded crime data and other city datasets available for download and API access.
